items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Does anybody remember from the radio days, a fella called Walter O’Keefe? ... He was one of the greats. Walter O’Keefe to me was like a Fred Allen or a Jack Benny.

ctx.x: He was terrific. He was terrific. He did all these little things without talking, then he’d come out with a banjo. And then we had a comedian on the show. Does anybody remember from the radio days, a fella called Walter O’Keefe?
